run_msmarco_exp_prep: run the cli to preprocess MSMARCO passages into train and dev JSONL splits
run_process_msmarco: run process_msmarco to convert a JSONL doc file into DPR train and dev split files
create_msmarco_train_dev_splits: create train and dev JSONL splits from MSMARCO experience data with a configurable dev percentage
refactor_process_msmarco: refactor process_msmarco to support additional passage fields or custom scoring logic
review_get_parser: review the get_parser argparse configuration for doc_path, output_dir_path, dev_pct, and debug flags
